نتمارض (form VI)
# نَتَمَارَضُ (natamāraḍu) /na.ta.maː.ra.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَارَضَ (tamāraḍa)
# نَتَمَارَضَ (natamāraḍa) /na.ta.maː.ra.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَارَضَ (tamāraḍa)
# نَتَمَارَضْ (natamāraḍ) /na.ta.maː.radˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَارَضَ (tamāraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
